title: Plan weekdays workout should be an option
body:
Great app but it should have the option of planning the week workouts with the workouts that you want. 
The option of custom plan isn’t really custom since you’ll have to do the workouts that the app selects for you and not the ones you want to do.
 It should be also possible to plan, for example, an specific lower body workout in a specific day.
I think that the planning option is the one that is really needs an improvement since the app has a lot of workouts.
author: Maria madeira

title: Âmbito insuficiente
body: Esta avaliação não incide na APP, que satisfaz, mas na âmbito dos workouts que são oferecidos. Tenho 70+ o que justifica que tenha pouca apetência por kick boxing e afins. Nesta fase da vida procura-se outro tipo de exercícios físico, nomeadamente Pilates, exercícios de equilíbrio, etc. Uma pesquisa online para exercícios para seniores mostra claramente aquilo de que estou a falar. A este respeito os vídeos e workouts propostos são claramente desajustados para esta faixa etária. Não basta apresentar um exercício para diferentes níveis de desempenho, é necessário ir bastante mais além.

author: evbrodrigues

title: Tries to look rich but is buggy
body: A few bugs I noticed: it has internal ‘awards’ which are the achievements. Those awards have very uncertain behaviour, like for a 7-workout week they count the recent workouts per day, not the longest. Other unexpected behaviour is that this app doesn’t count on iPhone’s step counter only, but reads this metric from external apps as well. As a result, it sums app the steps from different sources, and of course it looks better than it is.
author: RenatoShayan

title: Disappointing
body:
Very disappointed with this App. It relies on other applications to read steps. Strange! Then the funniest part is the monthly challenges!!! Never take into consideration age of the user (though its an Apple app and has user details)! Example they give a 70 year lady a challenge to walk 12.1 km 14 times a month or lose 550 calories!!! Elderly do want to keep fit and exercise but should not harm themselves trying to keep up !!!
Very simple, ignore or delete app!

title: Awful UX
body:
No option for rating the workouts. Some of the workout are so poorly explained by coaches that I want to avoid the, at all costs and there is no option to either dislike or hide them.

Some workouts are too easy and some are hard - I want to be able to at least save my feedback to avoid them.

No option to save liked workouts. There is a “star” feature, but I use it to save workouts for later.
author: Bababuy12

title: Podia melhorar…
body:
Conta os passos dados com o telefone e soma os dados com o relógio. Muitas vezes ando só com o relógio, tenho poucos passos dados com o telefone, quando atualizo a informação do relógio a app soma os dois. O relógio está sempre no braço, 24h, o telefone não deveria somar os dois!

Pior, emparelhei um Apple Watch, mudou os anéis de movimento para três e agora o meu relógio (não Apple) deixou de ser lido. Já desinstalei e desemparelhei os dois, já voltei emparelhar e instalar a app e está deixou de importar os dados do meu relógio amazfit! Já nem quero ouvir falar de Apple Watch… Como voltar a apenas um anel de movimento e a ler os dados como antes?

That’s important info for the swimmer: you reach the wall and see immediately on your watch the time you did ( that’s how Suunto does) Again the kcal info is rather useless ( maybe to check in the summary in the phone).
